DROP PROCEDURE [DW].[SP_CI_Cards_Retail]
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE PROC [DW].[SP_CI_Cards_Retail] AS
BEGIN

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'CI_Cards_Retail') 
BEGIN
   TRUNCATE TABLE  DW.CI_Cards_Retail;
END;

WITH DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT AS
(
    SELECT AccountID,CustomerSK,BANKSK,BRANCHSK,ACCOUNTSK,CustomerID,SourceSystemCode,ValidStartDate 
    FROM DW.DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT
    WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CCD' AND CurrentIndicator = 1 AND ShareIndicator = 'Y'


)
INSERT INTO   DW.CI_Cards_Retail
SELECT DISTINCT
    DCA.AccountId AS AccountID
    ,DCA.CustomerID AS CustomerID
    ,CASE WHEN DDC.GlobalCIF IS NOT NULL THEN REPLACE(DDC.GlobalCIF,'Global_CIF_','Entity_CIF_')
      ELSE CONCAT('Entity_CIF_', DDC.SourceSystemCode, '_', DDC.CustomerID) END AS EntityCIF
    ,DDC.FCBSCIF AS FCBSCIF
    ,DDB.BankID AS BankCode
    ,DDBR.BranchID AS BranchCode
    ,DDBR.BranchName AS BranchName
    ,DDBR.Area AS Area
    ,DDBR.Region AS Region
    ,DCA.SourceSystemCode AS Source
    ,DDP.ProductGroup AS ProductGrouping
    ,DDP.Productname AS ProductType
    ,CONCAT(DDP.ProductGroup,'-',DDP.ProductName) AS ProductDetails
    ,DDA.AccountOpenedDate AS OpenedDate
    ,DFC.RelationshipExposure AS RelationshipExposure
    ,DFL.StatementBalance AS StatementBalance
    ,DFLC.CurrentCreditLimit AS CreditLimit
    ,DFC.BusinessDateSK AS BusinessDate
    ,DCA.ValidStartDate AS LastUpdatedDate
    ,CONCAT(DCA.AccountId,DCA.CustomerID,DDB.BankID,DCA.SourceSystemCode) as AccountKey

FROM DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT DCA
    JOIN (SELECT CustomerSK ,FCBSCIF,GlobalCIF,SourceSystemCode,CustomerID FROM DW.DimCustomer WHERE CustomerType = 'Retail') DDC ON DCA.CustomerSK = DDC.CustomerSK
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT BANKSK,BankID FROM DW.DIMBANK) DDB ON DCA.BANKSK = DDB.BANKSK
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT BranchID,BranchName,Area,Region,BRANCHSK FROM DW.DIMBRANCH) DDBR ON DCA.BRANCHSK = DDBR.BRANCHSK
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT ACCOUNTSK,PRODUCTSK FROM DW.DIMACCOUNTPRODUCT) DAP ON DCA.ACCOUNTSK = DAP.ACCOUNTSK
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProductGroup,ProductName,PRODUCTSK FROM DW.DIMPRODUCT) DDP ON DAP.PRODUCTSK = DDP.PRODUCTSK 
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountOpenedDate,ACCOUNTSK FROM DW.DIMACCOUNT) DDA ON DCA.ACCOUNTSK = DDA.ACCOUNTSK
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT RelationshipExposure,BusinessDateSK,ACCOUNTSK  FROM DW.FACTCARDSRELATIONSHIPEXPOSURE WHERE BusinessDateSK = (SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM DW.FACTCARDSRELATIONSHIPEXPOSURE )) DFC ON DCA.ACCOUNTSK = DFC.ACCOUNTSK
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT ACCOUNTSK,StatementBalance FROM DW.FactCardsOutstandingBalance) DFL ON DCA.ACCOUNTSK = DFL.ACCOUNTSK
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT ACCOUNTSK,CurrentCreditLimit FROM DW.FactCardsCreditLimit) DFLC ON DCA.ACCOUNTSK = DFLC.ACCOUNTSK
    
GROUP BY
DCA.AccountId
,DCA.CustomerId
,DDC.CustomerID
,DDC.GlobalCIF
,DDC.SourceSystemCode
,DDB.BankId
,DDBR.BranchID
,DDBR.BranchName
,DDBR.Area
,DDBR.Region
,DCA.SourceSystemCode
,DDP.ProductGroup
,DDP.ProductName
,DDA.AccountOpenedDate
,DFC.BusinessDateSK
,DCA.ValidStartDate
,RelationshipExposure
,DFC.BusinessDateSK
,DFL.StatementBalance
,DFLC.CurrentCreditLimit
,DDC.FCBSCIF
END
GO
